# @kayjs/mcp Reference

> Zero-dependency MCP Streamable HTTP (`2025-03-26`) plugin exposing typed Kay `action()` handlers and standalone handlers as bearer-authenticated AI agent tools and resources.

## Imports

- `@kayjs/mcp`: `mcp`, `mcpTool`, `inspectMcpFootprint`, `formatMcpFootprint`, `formatLines`, `formatTable`, `pruneEmpty`, `truncateOutput`, `compactSchema`, `schemaToJsonSchema`, `MCP_PROTOCOL_VERSION`, `MAX_BATCH_SIZE`; types `McpOptions`, `McpTool`, `McpActionTool`, `McpHandlerTool`, `McpToolsRecord`, `McpResource`, `McpTokenSource`, `McpToolAnnotations`, `McpBudgetOptions`, `McpFootprint`, `McpToolFootprint`, `McpContentBlock`, `McpToolResult`, `McpPruneMode`, `PruneEmptyOptions`, `CompactListOptions`, `CompactSchemaOptions`, `JsonSchemaObject`.

## Plugin Setup (`mcp(options)`)

- `name` (`'kay-mcp'`), `version` (`'1.0.0'`), `instructions` (returned in `initialize`).
- `path`: HTTP endpoint (default `'/mcp/tools'`).
- `rateLimit`: `{ max, windowMs, key? } | false` (default 120 calls a minute per address, each method counted apart; past it `429` with `Retry-After`).
- `token`: `string | { env: string } | { file: string } | (() => string | undefined | Promise<string | undefined>)`. Unconfigured token returns `404`, and a production start refuses until it is set; missing/invalid `Authorization: Bearer <token>` returns `401`.
- `tools`: `Record<string, McpTool>` — each entry either wraps an existing Kay `action` (`{ action, description, ... }`) or defines `{ schema?, handler(input, ctx), description, ... }`. Wrap with `mcpTool(...)` for strict `format`/`handler` inference.
  - Per-tool options: `inputSchema`, `schemaRef` (references `options.schemas` to emit a compact stub in `tools/list` while keeping full server validation), `annotations` (`title`, `readOnlyHint`, `destructiveHint`, `idempotentHint`, `openWorldHint`), `format(output, input)`, `maxOutputChars`, `pruneEmpty`.
- `schemas`: shared schemas exposed on demand via auto-added `describe_schema` tool and `kay://schemas/<name>` resources.
- `resources`: `Record<uri, { name?, description?, mimeType?, read: string | ((ctx) => string | Promise<string>) }>`.
- Compact output & footprint options: `compactSchemas` (default `true`), `pruneEmpty` (`false | 'nullish' | true`), `maxOutputChars`, `formatResult(output, toolName, input)`, `mapError(err)`, `budget` (default `{ maxToolBytes: 2048 }`; `strict: true` fails `kay check`; `false` disables).

## Mounted Routes & CLI

- `POST /mcp/tools` (`csrf: false`, JSON-RPC 2.0: `initialize`, `tools/list`, `tools/call`, `resources/list`, `resources/read`, `ping`), `GET /mcp/tools` (`405`), `DELETE /mcp/tools` (`204`, `csrf: false`).
- `kay mcp-footprint` prints per-tool byte/token table; `kay check` and dev startup report `budget` violations.
- Output helpers: `formatLines(items, render, { total?, nextCursor?, empty? })`, `formatTable(rows, columns?, opts?)`, `pruneEmpty(val, opts?)`, `truncateOutput(text, maxChars)`.

## Snippet

```ts
// kay.config.ts
import { defineConfig } from '@kayjs/kay/config'
import { formatTable, mcp, mcpTool } from '@kayjs/mcp'
import { createTodo, listTodos } from './src/actions/todos'

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [
    mcp({
      name: 'todos',
      token: { env: 'MCP_TOKEN' },
      tools: {
        list_todos: mcpTool({
          action: listTodos,
          description: 'List open todos',
          annotations: { readOnlyHint: true },
          format: rows => formatTable(rows, ['id', 'title', 'done']),
        }),
        create_todo: mcpTool({ action: createTodo, description: 'Create a todo' }),
      },
    }),
  ],
})
```
